[[9 ABY]], [[Tatooine]]The flashback sequence in "[[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm]]" in which the [[COO-series cook droid]] was destroyed is set between "[[Chapter 5: The Gunslinger]]" and "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]." Per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]], Chapter 5 and Chapter 14 of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' are set around and in [[9 ABY]], respectively, placing the [[Cooking droid|cook droid's]] destructionon [[Tatooine]] around that [[Standard year|year]]. |creator= |manufacturer= |line= |model=[[COO-series cook droid]]{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} |class=[[Cooking droid|Kitchen droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height= |mass= |gender= |pronouns= |sensor=[[Color|White]] and green |plating=Brown and gray |armament= |equipment= |affiliation=[[Jabba's criminal empire]] }} {{Quote|What was that?''"
"''I don't know. More rats?''"

I will contact the rat catcher.|The COO-series droid and the EV-series sous-chef|}} A '''COO-series cook droid''' served in the kitchen of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] after it was taken over by [[Bib Fortuna]] following the [[death]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]]. When the former [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] and [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]] infiltrated the palace through a grate in the kitchen, the [[COO-series cook droid]] was preparing [[Foodstuff|food]] alongside a [[Unidentified EV-series sous-chef droid|EV-series sous-chef droid]]. The two [[droid]]s heard the sound of the grate, which the [[EV-series supervisor droid|EV-series]] guessed was a [[rat]]. The [[Cooking droid|cook droid]] sent the [[sous-chef]] droid to find the rat, contacting the [[Unidentified LEP-series service droid|LEP-series rat catcher]], but the EV droid was instead knocked down by Fett. Stepping out from behind its counter to confront Fett, the chef droid began to spin the knives on its six [[Limb|arms]]. However, before the droid could attack, Shand crept up behind it, slicing off its head. {{Droid-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|Sy5IsHN1XrA|Disney Gallery: The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-disney-gallery-star-wars-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-celebration-japan-2025-live-stage-droid-cooki|text=New Droid "Cooki" Makes His Debut on the ''Star Wars'' Celebration Japan LIVE!
